rules.rule: All IPC handlers must validate and sanitize input paths using helpers from this module. Check for path traversal vulnerabilities.
Tool implementations must enforce agent-scoped file permissions. Verify every file operation checks the effective agent scope before proceeding.
Electron main process code must follow security best practices: contextIsolation enabled, nodeIntegration disabled, sandbox where possible. Check for unsafe preload patterns.
Shared utilities must not introduce circular dependencies. Verify exports are well-typed and don't leak implementation details.
App server handlers must validate authentication and authorization for all mutating operations. Check for proper error handling without leaking internal details.
Browser extension code must follow MV3 best practices. Check for proper permission declarations, secure messaging, and content security policy compliance.
